title: PvE Toggle Beta Test: October 13-20
body:
# PvE Toggle Beta Test: October 13-20

Raiders,

Starting October 13 (11:00 CEST) and running through October 20 (11:00 CEST), ARC Raiders will be testing a PvE matchmaking toggle. Back in September, we shared background on why this test is happening now, and if you haven't seen that information yet, we suggest reading it first.

Ahead of the toggle going live, here's what this test means for you as a player:

# What to know

The PvE matchmaking toggle lets players choose between the usual PvPvE mode and new PvE servers. Several things will work differently on PvE servers:

* Players will not be able to deal damage to one another at all.

* Throwable items such as stun and fire grenades will have no effect on other players.

* Other physical interaction items, like barricades and ziplines, will work exactly as they do now.

* The total value of loot found on PvE servers will be reduced.

* Groups of different sizes will encounter each other more frequently, since squad separation will not be a matchmaking priority.

* PvE will not be available as an option on certain major map conditions, specifically Night Raid, Locked Gate, Hidden Bunker, Frigate, and Redirection.

* Downed players can still be re-acquired by ARC enemies. There's an eight-second grace period after going down during which ARC won't target you, but if you're caught moving once that window ends, you may be attacked.

* In regions with lower populations or during off-peak hours, matchmaking queue times could be longer. We'll be watching this closely to make sure everyone still gets good matches.

* PvPvE sessions will continue to use our existing matchmaking system as normal. This lets us collect solid data on how introducing a PvE toggle affects PvPvE matchmaking before we consider any major changes.

# What we need from you

Since this is a test, getting good data depends on you jumping in, trying out the changes, and sharing as much feedback as you can. If PvE is the mode you care most about and you'd like to see it developed further down the line, we're especially interested in hearing what's working well and what isn't.

The same goes if you're mainly a PvPvE player. Keep playing as usual and tell us whether the toggle changes your experience in any way, even if you don't expect to touch the PvE mode yourself.

Once the test wraps up, we'll be sending out a survey so you can share more detailed thoughts on your experience and tell us where you'd like to see the PvE option head next.

We're looking forward to seeing you there!

The ARC Raiders Team
